purpose: A low-cost, owner-facing conversation that clarifies the next campaign without becoming Product authority.

presentation.rule: The packet may retain a structured internal compilation map and an optional structured return channel. The owner-facing handoff must not expose the map, hashes, field names, or a forced checklist. Missing material answers remain unresolved rather than being filled from the packet.

question_inventory.rule: The packet carries the current typed question inventory. Policy and North Star changes use it to compile exact invalidated question IDs; root names alone are not sufficient.

packet.rule: The packet is read-only and content-addressed. It names what the conversation may clarify and what it may not change. The selected transport binds its handoff/return identity, while a shared link remains advisory. Project memory is continuity context only and never overrides the current exact packet.

campaign_shape.rule: The task profile is explicit so each available review level can explain its economy, speed, and difficulty fit for this specific proposed campaign.

model_plan.floor_rule: Every level and role candidate carries structured economy, speed, difficulty-fit, and reason guidance. An unavailable or below-floor model is not a valid recommendation. The Orchestrator chooses from the admitted host catalog and records economics and completion evidence.

transports.PRIVATE_MARKDOWN: Recommended. The user may return an ordinary Markdown note; an adapter may also carry a separate structured payload.
transports.PRIVATE_GIT: The return binds an admitted repository, branch, commit, and tree.
transports.CONNECTED_PRIVATE_CHAT: The connector binds the exact project, conversation, identity, and return integrity.
transports.SHARED_LINK_ADVISORY: Advisory only. It cannot carry exact approval or sensitive project evidence.

approval.activation_rule: Only OWNER_AUTHENTICATED_EXACT_APPROVAL over the exact approval-packet digest can admit the candidate. The conversation return itself cannot activate a campaign.

campaign_identity_binding.rule: The Controller candidate remains the canonical campaign identity. A separate audit checkpoint is acceptable only when its campaign/version, policy, acceptance, source commit/tree, terminal audit plan, and settled reconciliation are validated into this content-addressed mapping. The approval packet must bind the mapping to the exact Controller candidate digest.

cancellation.rule: Cancellation is content-addressed and leaves current policy, campaign, Product writes, and Product-agent spawns unchanged.

hostile_cases: review packet cannot become an active campaign
no Product agent spawn during review
memory cannot override the current handoff
Chat cannot authorize spending or deployment
